sources.snippet: Expanded OCR: Supports 32 languages (up from 19); robust in low light, blur, and tilt; better with rare/ancient characters and jargon; improved long-document structure parsing. Text Understanding on par with pure LLMs: Seamless text-vision fusion for lossless, unified comprehension. Referenced from the Qwen3-VL model card.
